propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded, conflating 'author forgot' with 'ticket touches no repo file', so a third explicit state is needed.

The FILE_IMPACT event gains optional file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys, deriving scope as paths/none/undeclared via a pure helper applied in process_file_impact with last-writer-wins replacement.
The set-file-impact CLI command moves to the variadic argv registry and accepts a new '--none <reason>' form alongside the existing JSON-array form, with exactly one form required.
A no-file-impact reason must have at least 10 non-whitespace characters or the command exits 2 naming the non-whitespace rule and writes no event.
A new library function get_file_impact_scope returns {kind, reason, paths}, get-file-impact output stays byte-for-byte unchanged, and rebar show surfaces the two new state keys.
A dedicated MCP write tool declare_no_file_impact returns a string ack with no outputSchema, applies the same reason validation as the CLI, and writes identical reducer state.
